summary: Excellent workflow YAML and TypeScript code quality—pinned action refs (v4/v7), explicit types throughout, proper error handling with meaningful messages, set -euo pipefail. However, deliverable is NON-FUNCTIONAL: missing critical files referenced by workflow: package.json (bun/tsc deps), tsconfig.json, bun.lock, rules.json, fixtures/case-*.json. Lines 60 `bun install`, 63 `bunx tsc`, 66-67 `fixtures/*.json` will fail. Minor: FILES_TO_COPY in run-act-tests.ts (~line 109) manually maintained—fragile when adding files. Cannot validate with actionlint or act without these supporting files.
